owner_references.label: current-ikea-fuller-v2
owner_references.scope: Separate source-aware current-owner reference. Tagged CSV has different input law and no checksum; raw median/accounting verification plus captured native receipt, not full-archive revalidation.

origins.execution: not imported or executed by reports

limits: Selection is complete and bounded. Retention/promotion is owned by the lead; no worker is launched by the selector.
All raw timing CSVs, policy receipts, executable order and context bytes are preserved; identical context/receipt payloads can share one indexed file with multiple exact origins.
Every payload hash must be verified by the checkout-owned report before recomputing. Report must not import/execute any code found in an archive or selected inputs.
Independent key-law checksum/request recomputation is separate from captured executable full-answer/terminal/individual-found checks; CSV does not expose terminal or per-request traces.

Source/compile/binary/native/sanitizer qualification comes from exact selected captured audit receipts. Offline report over selected data verifies their identity and reports their declared scope; it does not claim to repeat omitted full-archive or native executable checks.
Logical stage visits/hint targets and instruction excerpts are not PMU stalls, IPC, cache misses or branch prediction measurements.
No single register-pressure/scheduling variant is a universal gain. Retain all negative controls; compare within matched jobs and disclose pass-order ratio drift.
Current Ikea Fuller owner evidence is referenced separately; the frozen old row-key campaign does not justify rewriting its already-independent next-key native path.

Full plain-branch native panel is retained as measured, including ARM H0 hot-C32 regression and Zen C1 regression. Narrowed ARM hinted-only reproduction selector is proof-defined and not a new native measurement.
